item.title: Camera Calibration Explained: An Interactive OpenCV Lab
item.description: Every rover that navigates with a camera relies on a handful of numbers it rarely shows you: the focal length, the optical center, the camera pose and the way the lens bends straight lines. This is camera calibration, and when those numbers are wrong, visual odometry drifts, stereo depth is off and obstacles appear where they are not. If you are building anything on top of autonomous rover navigation, you will meet the pinhole camera model sooner or later.
